## What's new
- **Faster code with the Ornith team's own draft model.** Astronomical now uses the Ornith team's first-generation DFlash draft model, `ornith-ai/Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B-DFlash`, beside the DFlash2 draft models it already used. A draft model guesses the next few words and the main model checks them all in one step. Every word is still the main model's own choice. - **Two new models in Observatory's Models page.** Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B-MLX-4bit-vision-DFLASH and Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B-MLX-6bit-vision-DFLASH are the Ornith team's own 4-bit and 6-bit builds. Each has its original vision put back, so it reads pictures, and its own draft model packed in.
Measured on an M5 Pro with 48 GB at temperature 0.6, in tokens per second:
| | Writing an essay | Writing code | |---|---|---| | 4-bit, no draft model | 95.2 | 95.9 | | 4-bit vision with its draft model | 85.2 | 122.1 | | 6-bit, no draft model | 72.5 | 70.7 | | 6-bit vision with its draft model | 62.6 | 89.4 |
Code comes out about a quarter faster. Essays come out a little slower, because everyday writing has many reasonable ways to continue, so fewer of the draft model's guesses are kept.
## Fixes
- A damaged draft model download is refused instead of stopping the engine.
## Compatibility
- Your settings, conversations and downloaded models are kept. No setting changed. - Models that already draft with a DFlash2 draft model keep it. - Requires macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon.
The app and disk image are signed with Developer ID, notarized and stapled by Apple, and the update feed is signed.
